answer: The cedar counter is kept in jetty and ledge makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 47 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An copycat therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 47 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1256 identities would post 3842 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
